movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Vigorous shaking of the thoracic region and upper body (ukutyityimba).

signature_moves.description: A vigorous shaking of the thoracic region and the rest of the upper body.
signature_moves.name: Ukutyityimba

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Varies by category; slow for Umngqungqo, rhythmic for others.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid disrespectful imitation of ritual movements; ensure barefoot safety on appropriate surfaces.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Rhythmic pulse provided by clapping and drums.
music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by the resonant twang of the Uhadi bow, the steady beat of drums, and the piercing, high-pitched sound of the Ingcongolo reed whistle, all layered under rhythmic clapping and vocal chanting.

basic_steps: Barefoot stomping to the rhythm of the drum or clapping.
Engaging the thoracic region to perform the ukutyityimba shoulder shake.
Coordinating upper body shaking with the rhythmic footwork.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners should focus on the coordination of the shoulder shake (ukutyityimba) while maintaining a steady, grounded stomp.
teaching.rhythm: Rhythmic pulse provided by drums, clapping, or vocal ukombela.
